p.s: Dear Helen Ryan,
It was grateful for your message.
I can gladly give you some information which you need.
I would be able to travel only in July because I have a job at the moment, but it will be my vacation in July.
I would prefer to be in tents, so that I could enjoy a nature life more than being log cabins.
Moreover, it would be more exciting for me.
It could be nice for doing two activities while I am at the Camp.
I am interested in sports.
Especially, I am wonderful at swimming.
I have swimmed since I was in primary school.
I would like to learn playing golf at the Camp.
I have never played golf in my life.
Is it possible to learn playing golf, although I am not good at golf?
Would you mind giving some answer whether I need some clothes and money at the Camp?
I look forward to hearing from you.
Yours sincerely,
